title: Bring Ccusage up to Intent spec
objective:
Ccusage was added to Intent on 2026-11-03 to track ISSUE:0001 to ISSUE:0003. Bring it up to the spec of an Intent project, so that every session gets the same contract, every commit passes the same gate, and the whiteboard has a declared roster.

- WP01 (dc): declare the project's languages (`intent lang init rust shell`), apply Intent's Claude canon and git gate (`intent claude upgrade --apply`), resync `AGENTS.md`, drop README's stale "Intent integration is intentionally deferred" line, take the first `intent backup`.
- WP02 (vc): declare the whiteboard roster (`intent/whiteboard/README.md`, register `hv`, name vc as the reader of `hv/inbox.*`) and replace the template `intent/wip.md`.
- WP03 (vc): once ISSUE:0002 lands, record the Keychain access decision in `intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE.md` and its never-rule in `intent/llm/RULES.md`.

Done when `intent doctor` is clean with no advisory, the pre-commit gate runs the critics and doctor on a real commit, and a fresh session's `/in-session` loads the Rust and shell rules and picks up the declared roster.

wps.title: Declare languages, install Intent's Claude canon and git gate, resync AGENTS.md
wps.objective: Declare rust and shell with `intent lang init rust shell`. Apply Intent's Claude canon and git gate with `intent claude upgrade --apply` (.claude/settings.json, .mcp.json, usage-rules.md, .intent_critic.yml, and the pre-commit, post-merge, post-checkout and post-rewrite hooks). Resync AGENTS.md with `intent agents sync`, drop README's "Intent integration is intentionally deferred" line, and take the first `intent backup`. This satisfies AC-01.1, AC-01.2 and AC-01.3, and the backup half of AC-00.1. The gate body runs from the install pointer (/Users/matts/Devel/prj/Intent), not the brew binary, as `intent claude upgrade` reports.

wps.title: Declare the whiteboard roster and seed the project records
wps.objective: Declare the whiteboard roster in intent/whiteboard/README.md (hv, vc and dc, with vc the named reader of hv/inbox.*), register hv, and replace the template intent/wip.md with the current focus. This satisfies AC-02.1 and AC-02.2.

wps.title: Record the Keychain access decision in ARCHITECTURE.md and RULES.md
wps.objective: Once ISSUE:0002 lands, record in intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE.md why ccusage reaches Claude's Keychain items only through /usr/bin/security, the way Claude Code does, and put the matching never-rule in intent/llm/RULES.md. This satisfies AC-03.1.
